annotations.title: AI company brief: identity, SEC, sanctions, domain risk

description: Company due-diligence brief for a domain, name or ticker: Wikidata and GLEIF identity (legal name, LEI, HQ country, website, founding), SEC EDGAR ticker, CIK, periodic filings, 8-K events (last 180 days), XBRL revenue, net income, assets and cash copied from source, OFAC sanctions screening, domain registration and risk flags. Overview and risk notes are AI-generated by Anthropic Claude from that data and the homepage text; not investment or legal advice. Sources listed. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

domain.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. apple.com. At least one of domain, name or ticker is required; they can be combined.

name.description: Company name, 2 to 100 characters, e.g. Apple Inc. Matched against Wikidata labels and GLEIF legal names.

ticker.description: US stock ticker from the SEC company tickers list, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B.
